name: Jeush
overview: The name Jeush appears in Scripture as belonging to several distinct individuals, illustrating the diversity of God's providential care over His people. Jeush is notably recorded as a son of Esau through Aholibamah, highlighting his place within the Edomite lineage (Genesis 36:5,14,18). Additionally, Jeush is mentioned among the sons of Shimei in the Levitical genealogies, specifically as a Gershonite Levite, reflecting a priestly heritage though with fewer descendants (1 Chronicles 23:10-11). These references emphasize the historical and tribal distinctions preserved in Scripture, underscoring God's sovereign hand in the unfolding of His covenant people.
